Data-Driven Emotion LoRAs — Ablation on the v2 Voice-Acting Model

Idea. Prompting alone failed to push Anger/Amusement. So instead we fine-tune a small LoRA per emotion on strongly-emotional audio (top clips from an emotion-reference corpus, re-tokenized with the MOSS codec, mixed with our synthetic neutral-ref→emotional set), and test whether loading that LoRA lets the same emotional prompt actually produce the emotion. Ablation: rank 64 vs 128, and number of epochs (via checkpoints).

How to read (for dummies). z = EmoNet score for the target emotion as a z-score (how far above an average clip; higher = more of that emotion). We compare the baseline (v2, same prompt, no LoRA) to the model with the emotion LoRA at each checkpoint. Lift = best z − baseline z (how much the LoRA adds). spk = speaker similarity to the reference voice (higher = voice preserved). Curves show z rising with training; the best epoch is the peak before it overfits.
